title: Geo-distributed passive-promotion safety net and progressive fallback plan
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Define, validate, and automate a conservative active->passive promotion workflow for a geo-distributed active-passive topology that minimizes user-visible disruption while ensuring data integrity. The plan focuses on progressive traffic ramp, hysteresis-aware circuit breaker behavior, and automated rollback gating tied to SLO/EB (error budget) signals. This ticket produces an executable drill runbook, synthetic test harnesses, telemetry gating thresholds, and a post-mortem checklist for scheduled failover drills.
acceptance_criteria: A runnable drill runbook stored in runbooks/ with step-by-step checks and a designated operator checklist
Automated synthetic traffic generator (k-drill) that can emulate production request mix and token distributions for 0.1x, 1x, and 2x load
KV prefix warming script that validates prefix-level KV consistency within 60s for warm sinks on promotion
Circuit breaker hysteresis tuned such that 95% of steady-state promotions close without triggering emergency rollback under 1x synthetic load
Rollforward and rollback automation tested in staging with documented GitHub PRs and console playbook links
Telemetry: dashboards show SLO (p99 latency), error budget burn rate, 5xx rate, queue depth, and promoted-region CPU/GPU utilization; alerts fire accurately for threshold violations
runbook_steps: Prep: Confirm latest snapshot and incremental backups are available (S3://redwood-backups/regions/utc/YYYYMMDDHH). Attach snapshot ID to ticket.
Step 1 - Quiesce non-critical background jobs in target passive region (30m window). Set label 'drill-quiesced' in orchestration UI
Step 2 - Bootstrap KV warmup: run kv-warmup --prefix=promoted/ --validate-against=primary --concurrency=8; expect <0.1% mismatch across 100k keys
Step 3 - Deploy promotion token (idempotent) with TTL=15m. Token flips routing in a single atomic update to traffic router with canary fraction=0.05
Step 4 - Progressive ramp: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% for 20m. At each step validate: p99 latency within threshold, 5xx < 0.1%, backlog < 500ms

Step 5 - Circuit breaker gates: if any of (p99 latency increase > 30% over baseline, sustained 5xx > 0.2% for 2m, or error budget burn > 10% in 10m) then automatically detraffic to previous active and mark for investigation
Step 6 - Data fidelity checks: run spot-checks using idempotent read/write verification for session tokens and in-flight KV keys. Use snapshot compare tool and reconcile discovered diffs
Step 7 - Post-cutover warm cache policy: keep prefix cache alive for 2 hours with progressive TTL decay to avoid cold-start storms
Step 8 - Clean up: revoke promotion token, record metrics, attach logs and PR links to ticket, and run post-drill survey with SRE/Platform/PM/Dev teams
test_plan: Staging run: full promotion sequence under 1x synthetic load; expected success with no auto-rollback and telemetry within thresholds
Stress run: promotion under 2x synthetic load to validate load-shedding behavior and circuit-breaker hysteresis; ensure controlled detraffic occurs and rollback is clean
KV-resync failure injection: inject a 5% mismatch scenario and validate that the runbook halts promotion and triggers manual investigation workflow
Regional-network-loss simulation: simulate 30s packet loss and verify promotion token atomicity and routing fallback works without split-brain
Rollback validation: perform forced rollback and validate session affinity and KV consistency restored within 3m
rollback_plan: Automated rollback trigger conditions listed in Step 5 of runbook_steps
Manual rollback instructions: revoke promotion token, run named rollback job rollback-promote --snapshot=<last-known-good>, and wait for route convergence (expected <120s)
Post-rollback integrity: run kv-reconcile --since=<promotion-start> and escalate if unresolved diffs > 0.05%
User communication: Post abbreviated incident update to status.redwood.com and internal #infra-dr channel with timeline and next steps
telemetry_and_alerts: Dashboards to create/update: DR Cutover Overview, Promoted Region Health, KV Fidelity Check, Circuit-Breaker Events
Key metrics: p99 request latency, 5xx rate, queued requests, sync-lag-ms for KV replicas, GPUUtilization-per-node

Alerts and runbook bindings: DR_PROMOTION_LAT_SLO (p99 > baseline*1.3 for 2m) -> on-call SRE; DR_5XX_SPIKE (5xx > 0.2% sustained 2m) -> promote rollback; DR_KV_MISMATCH (diff rate > 0.1%) -> halt promotion
Event correlation: annotate runbook steps with trace IDs and link to APM traces for fast RCA
